verdict.rationale: Trilegal documents a dedicated Intellectual Property practice whose team advises on trademarks and handles high-stakes litigation involving trademarks, which covers brand enforcement. It sits on a single combined IP page, though, and trademark clearance and registration are never named. missing for 10: explicit trademark clearance/search services, trademark registration/prosecution work, a distinct trademark or brand-protection team, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: Our team advises on the full spectrum of IP, including trademarks, copyrights, patents, designs, trade secrets, and confidential information
Representing clients in high-stakes litigation involving patents, trademarks, copyrights, design rights, trade secrets
